have any voaters had experience putting games on steam greenlight? if so, whats the process like?

I have! I put my game up back in October. Pay your $100 and basically go thru the quick process of making your page. Nothing special about it. Click the launch button and you are up. Traffic dies about after the 3rd day because you are no longer on the front so be prepared when you launch. Being prepared means... Videos, Animated gifs, Pictures, Description.... Just make it look good!

I have yet to get Greenlighted because of weakness in all those areas and making a platformer but other avenues are opening up like itch.io or indiegamestand.com so things are looking good for small time devs. Steam hasn't said much in awhile about Greenlight but back in 2014 they said they wanted to make Greenlight go away... so we'll see!
